$comment: URU-A09 AC #1: single source of truth for the module catalog. Read at compile time by compile-service (validation + Solidity splicing) and at runtime by web (module picker, param inputs, config-hash preview). Each module entry carries: (a) core protocol fields — version, base, requires, incompatibleWith, flagged, fragmentPath, templateOverride, params (JSON Schema), abiEncode — consumed by the splicer/validator; (b) `ui` — label, category, status, description — presentation-only overlays consumed by the shop; (c) `capabilities` — requiresOwner / taxesTransfers — booleans mirroring the Router bitmap flags (FLAG_REQUIRES_OWNER, FLAG_BALANCE_MUTATING) so a single edit updates both the frontend gate and the on-chain policy view. Each param property may add a `ui` object with a friendlier form contract (label, type ∈ percent|eth|integer|address|string|boolean, default, hint); this overlays the JSON Schema which stays the server-side validation contract. Modules WITHOUT `fragmentPath` are not compilable through /compile — they are either post-graduation hooks deployed as standalone contracts (LPLocked, FeeRedirect, MultiHookHost, AntiSniper, BuybackBurn) or planned modules (status='planned') the shop greys out.

ui.label: ✿ bot gate
ui.description: keeps snipers out for the first few blocks. only wallets u trust can grab tokens while the gate is up ~ turns off on its own after the window

blockGate.description: Number of blocks after initialize during which non-owner senders can only send to allowlisted recipients.

ui.label: how many blocks?
ui.hint: each block ≈ 12 sec on eth. 5 is normal ~ higher = safer but ppl wait longer to trade ✿

ui.label: ✿ tax on trade
ui.description: every trade pays a small tax. u decide how much gets burned forever (deflation ~) vs sent to a wallet u control

feeBps.description: Fee in basis points (1 = 0.01%). Capped at 30%.

ui.label: tax per trade (%)
ui.hint: how much every trade pays into the tax pool. capped at 30% ~

burnBps.description: Portion of fee that's burned. burnBps + treasuryBps must equal 10000.

ui.label: burn slice (%)
ui.hint: of the tax above, how much gets destroyed forever

treasuryBps.description: Portion of fee routed to treasury.

ui.label: wallet slice (%)
ui.hint: the rest. burn + wallet must add up to exactly 100 ~

ui.label: wallet address
ui.hint: where the wallet slice lands. paste ur wallet or a multisig ✿

ui.label: ✿ art lives on-chain
ui.description: each nft gets rendered right on the chain — no ipfs, no server, forever. as long as ethereum exists, ur art exists ~

ui.label: ✿ resale royalties
ui.description: opensea, blur & the rest check ur royalty setting and forward a cut on every resale. enforcement is up to them tho ~

ui.label: royalty wallet
ui.hint: where royalties land. u can change this after launch ✿

feeBps.description: Royalty in basis points. Capped at 10%.

ui.label: royalty (%)
ui.hint: what marketplaces send u on every resale. capped at 10%

ui.label: ✿ whale caps
ui.description: caps how much any wallet can hold + how much can move in one trade. runs for N blocks after launch then turns off ~ so whales cant just camp on ur launch

ui.label: max per wallet
ui.hint: biggest wallet balance allowed while caps are on. in ur token units ~

ui.label: max per trade
ui.hint: biggest single transfer allowed while caps are on

ui.label: how many blocks?
ui.hint: 1000 ≈ 3 hrs on eth. after this, caps turn off entirely

Pausable.flagged: pause freezes ALL transfers, including yours. even you cant move or sell while paused ~ centralization tradeoff, ppl will notice

ui.label: ✿ emergency pause
ui.description: u can pause every transfer (including your own). safety net for emergencies. holders see the pause switch and get spooked, so think twice ~

ui.label: ✿ soulbound
ui.description: nft can never be transferred after mint. good for badges, memberships, poaps ~ only mint + burn work

ui.label: ✿ delayed reveal
ui.description: art stays hidden til u pull the reveal trigger. every nft shows a placeholder image until u call reveal() ~

hiddenBaseURI.description: URI prefix served for every token until reveal().

ui.label: placeholder art link
ui.hint: the image ppl see before reveal. ipfs:// or https:// both work ✿

ui.label: ✿ gasless approvals
ui.description: lets holders approve trades with a signature instead of a whole tx (saves gas). standard on modern tokens ~

ui.label: ✿ refundable mint
ui.description: paid mint with a safety net. buyers can burn their nft within N blocks to get their money back — anti-rug for paid drops ✿

pricePerToken.description: Mint price per token in wei. Buyer must send exactly price*qty on refundableMint.

ui.label: price per nft (ETH)
ui.hint: what buyers pay each. type the ETH amount ~

refundWindowBlocks.description: Blocks post-mint during which buyer can burn to reclaim price.

ui.label: refund window (blocks)
ui.hint: 43,200 ≈ 6 days on eth. how long buyers can burn-to-refund

ui.label: ✿ voteable token
ui.description: makes ur token voteable. holders can delegate voting power to themselves or someone else. u need this if u want a dao later ~

ui.label: ✿ per-item supply cap
ui.description: cap how many of each item can exist. items u dont cap stay unlimited ~

ids.description: Token IDs to cap. Any id not in this list stays uncapped.

caps.description: Max supply for each id (equal-length with ids).

ui.label: max supply per item (comma-separated)
ui.hint: same order + count as the ids ~

ui.label: ✿ paid mint per item
ui.description: public mint at a fixed price per item. buyers send eth + get the item, u sweep proceeds later ~

pricesWei.description: Price per token in wei for each id (equal-length with ids).

ui.label: prices in wei (comma-separated)
ui.hint: one price per item, same order as ids. in wei bc these can be huge numbers ~

ui.label: ✿ paid mint (fee split)
ui.description: same as paid mint but every mint routes a platform slice to FeeSplitter automatically. use this over payable-mint when u want the launchpad-fee wiring built in ~

pricesWei.description: Price per token in wei for each id (equal-length with ids).

ui.label: prices in wei (comma-separated)
ui.hint: one price per item, same order as ids

platformFeeReceiver.description: FeeSplitter address that receives the platform bps of each mint.

ui.label: platform fee receiver
ui.hint: FeeSplitter address

platformFeeBps.description: Platform's basis-point cut of every mint. Must be < 10000.

ui.label: platform cut (bps)
ui.hint: basis points — 1000 = 10%. must be < 10000

ui.label: ✿ resale royalties (1155)
ui.description: same as the nft royalty module but for multi-item drops. same royalty applies across every item id ~

ui.label: royalty wallet
ui.hint: where royalties land ~

ui.label: royalty (%)
ui.hint: what marketplaces send u on every resale. capped at 10%

ui.label: ✿ staking pool
ui.description: stake this token to earn more of this token. u fund the reward pool up-front, rewards stream out linearly over the window ~ (doesnt stack with tax-on-trade, airdrop, or vesting for now)

rewardsTotal.description: Total reward tokens distributed over the period (wei).

ui.label: reward pool (tokens)
ui.hint: how many tokens ur putting up for the whole staking window

ui.label: how long? (seconds)
ui.hint: 2,592,000 = 30 days. how long rewards stream out for

ui.label: ✿ vesting schedule
ui.description: one wallet, one unlock schedule. tokens unlock linearly from cliff to end date ~ no reserve needed, minted as they vest

ui.label: who gets the tokens
ui.hint: wallet that receives the vested amount ~

totalAmount.description: Total amount to vest in wei.

ui.label: total tokens
ui.hint: full amount that vests over the schedule

cliffTimestamp.description: Unix seconds. No release before this.

ui.label: cliff (unix seconds)
ui.hint: when unlocks start. use a unix timestamp — date pickers ship soon ~

endTimestamp.description: Unix seconds. Full amount vested at or after this.

ui.label: end (unix seconds)
ui.hint: when everything is fully unlocked

ui.label: ✿ lp locked forever
ui.description: liquidity gets locked in uniswap forever. no one — not even u — can pull it. classic anti-rug ~ this is why urufu labs exists

ui.label: ✿ swap fee → u
ui.description: every uniswap swap sends a slice of the output to ur wallet (creator) and a slice to urufu labs. u claim ur fees whenever — max 30% combined

ui.label: ur wallet
ui.hint: where ur cut lands. bake it right — this cant change after launch ~

ui.label: urufu cut (%)
ui.hint: what urufu labs takes per swap ~ default 1%

ui.label: ur cut (%)
ui.hint: what u take per swap. up to 30%

ui.label: ✿ sniper gate
ui.description: blocks trades on uniswap for the first N seconds after the pool opens. adds + minting still work — only swapping is gated. auto-expires ~

ui.label: how many seconds?
ui.hint: 60 seconds catches bots. rounded up to the next ethereum block (12 sec each) on chain ~

ui.label: ✿ lp lock + swap fee (combo)
ui.description: lp lock and swap fee combined into one. u need this if u want both, bc uniswap only lets one hook attach per pool ~

ui.label: ur wallet
ui.hint: where ur cut lands. cant change this after launch ~

ui.label: urufu cut (%)
ui.hint: what urufu labs takes per swap

ui.label: ur cut (%)
ui.hint: what u take per swap

ui.label: ✿ buy → burn
ui.description: every time someone buys ur token, a slice of the buy gets destroyed. supply shrinks a lil every trade — pure deflation flywheel ~

ui.label: burn (%)
ui.hint: 0.01% to 20%. slice of every buy that goes straight to dead ~

B20PolicyAware.flagged: Reduces decentralization — every transfer is gated by an external PolicyRegistry the launcher configures. Same tradeoff as USDC-style compliance layers.

ui.label: B20 — PolicyRegistry aware
ui.description: Defers every transfer to a Base PolicyRegistry contract. The registry decides whether msg.sender / from / to are allowed to move the token — used for KYC-gated markets, jurisdictional restrictions, and sanctions checks. Base-first (mainnet + Base Sepolia); other chains would need their own PolicyRegistry equivalent.

ui.label: PolicyRegistry address
ui.hint: On-chain compliance registry the token will consult on every transfer. Immutable in the deployed token.

Blocklist.flagged: Reduces decentralization — owner can freeze arbitrary addresses at any time. Same mechanism USDC + USDT use for sanctions compliance.

ui.label: Blocklist — freeze specific addresses
ui.description: Owner can block any address from sending or receiving the token. Blocked addresses can still hold their balance but every transfer reverts until they're unblocked. Meant for compliance / sanctions use cases — flagged so launchers know it's a censorship vector.

Jailable.flagged: Reduces decentralization — owner can seize tokens from any address (typically already blocklisted). The strongest censorship primitive we offer.

ui.label: Jailable — recover seized funds
ui.description: Owner can move tokens out of a blocklisted address into a designated recovery address. Used to reclaim funds from sanctioned wallets or compromised accounts. Requires the Blocklist module — you can only jail tokens from an already-frozen address. Flagged as the strongest censorship primitive.
